items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: "Don't love with this Gustafella, you know, when he's doing something, you know. Don't love with this. Just encourage him, you know."

ctx.x: I'll start out by saying this is an interview with Mr. Steve Angram and the date is August the 8th, 1961. We're out at his home at 2105 Allen Street. Do you want to give your full name Mr. Angram? Stephen Angram. Any middle name? No, no middle name.

You were saying when you left Chalini, I guess you knew the horn pretty good, but you still not what you'd call a great clarinet player yet. No, no. You still had quite a long ways to go? I had a long ways to go after I left there. Well, how do you figure that you became so good? Well, by playing with different good bands. In other words, picking up ideas? Picking up ideas from other bands. And working them out yourself? Yeah, working them out myself. When I was sitting in a band playing as a good band, I'd get…
